entry.title: Oregon Sues SpaceX and X Over Sexualized Images Created by Grok
entry.summary: Oregon is suing SpaceX, X Corp. and two related companies, alleging they misled users about safeguards meant to prevent Grok from creating sexualized images of adults and children without their permission.

entry.title: Rain Likely in Roseburg on Thanksgiving After a Mild Wednesday
entry.summary: Roseburg could reach 60 degrees Wednesday before rain moves in late that night. Thanksgiving has a 90% chance of rain, with up to half an inch possible. A Coastal Flood Warning includes Reedsport from Tuesday morning through Thursday evening.

entry.title: Nature Writer Marina Richie to Speak at Roseburg Public Library Dec. 9
entry.summary: Nature writer Marina Richie will discuss her book Feathered Forest at 6 p.m. Wednesday, Dec. 9, at Roseburg Public Library. The free program will also feature wildlife biologist Janice Reed, who will discuss her research on spotted and barred owls.

entry.title: Umpqua Singers to Bring Jazz and ’60s R&B to UCC Concert Tuesday
entry.summary: The Umpqua Singers will perform jazz, 1960s R&B and popular favorites at 7 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, at UCC’s Whipple Fine Arts Center. Tickets are $15 general admission and $10 for seniors at the door. Students get in free.

entry.title: Bike the Lights Returns to River Forks Park Monday Night

entry.title: Oregon Joins Dollar General Lawsuit Over Alleged Checkout Overcharges
entry.summary: Oregon joined a federal lawsuit alleging Dollar General charged shoppers more at checkout than advertised. The state is asking the court to order refunds for affected customers, impose penalties and require the retailer to fix its pricing.

entry.title: Oregon Expands Building Code Options To Allow More Four-Unit Housing Developments
entry.summary: Oregon has approved a new building code option allowing qualifying residential buildings to contain up to four dwelling units, providing greater design flexibility for smaller multifamily housing projects statewide.

entry.title: Oregon Offers Two Days Of Free Fishing, Crabbing And Clamming After Thanksgiving
entry.summary: Oregon residents and visitors can enjoy free fishing, crabbing and clamming November 27-28. No licenses or tags are required, but all other fishing regulations remain in effect.

entry.title: Douglas County To Launch Free Mattress Recycling Program At Roseburg Transfer Station
entry.summary: Douglas County is launching a free mattress recycling program November 25 at the Roseburg Transfer Station. Residents can drop off up to three eligible mattresses per day at no cost, provided they meet recycling requirements.

entry.title: Rain Returns To Roseburg Saturday As Wetter Weather Moves Into Southern Oregon Ahead Of Thanksgiving
